title: Unified Page Headers & Scroll Fix
description: Consistent compact headers across all Hub pages and fixed bottom content clipping on scroll.
highlights: Workflow, Insights, Calendar, Inventory, Progress, and Admin headers match Agency Overview sizing
Fixed scroll clipping at the bottom of Workflow and other long pages
Compact title (text-lg), subtitle (text-xs), and rounded-xl action buttons throughout

title: Sidebar Navigation Polish
description: Consistent sidebar sizing, branding, and layout across all Hub pages.
highlights: Update KPIs, Admin Panel, and Logout match compact nav item size
Inventory and My Progress use the Agency Hub logo in the sidebar header
Fixed extra top spacing on Overview and Insights pages
Collapsible sidebar on Inventory and My Progress pages

title: Grouped Sidebar Navigation
description: Sidebar navigation is now organized into collapsible groups to save space as the platform grows.
highlights: Workflow group: Workflow + Agency Overview
Insights group: Insights + Reports (+ Event Coverage)
Published Posts group: Published Posts + Content Calendar
My Progress and Inventory remain standalone top-level items
Groups remember open/closed state; auto-expand when you're on a child page

title: Theme Screenshot
description: Added theme screenshot thumbnail for WordPress Appearance and Updates screens.
highlights: Theme now includes screenshot.png — shows in WP theme picker and update list

title: Equipment Inventory
description: New Inventory section for the agency team. Track cameras, lenses, lighting, and all production gear. Staff can request bookings for shoots and client events; managers approve via Hub notifications and email.
highlights: Inventory page in sidebar — staff only, clients cannot access
Equipment dashboard: total, available, checked out, needs servicing counts
Add/edit equipment with name, model, serial number, category, condition status
Staff request bookings for shoots/events with pickup and return dates
Managers/admins approve or decline — email + Hub + Google Space notifications
Check out on shoot day, check in when returned

title: Content Bank Integration & Progress Clarity
description: Production projects can now be sent directly to the Content Bank for client approval. The stats strip now shows a Delivered card and a separate Overdue indicator. Team Progress cards show per-goal detail rows with actual counts, clearer labels, and helpful hints for Social Media Execs.
highlights: Send to Client Portal button — push any production (in Client Review or later) to Content Bank so the client can approve it
Content Bank stats: awaiting client approval count now reflects productions sent for review
Stats strip: replaced Overdue card with Delivered; Overdue now shown as a separate read-only indicator
Team Progress: per-goal rows now show label + current/target count (e.g. 1 / 1 production) instead of anonymous bars
Multimedia goals: goals with no projects assigned this period are now excluded from score (no longer penalised)
Social Media Exec 'No Data' now shows a hint to set monthly targets in Admin → Clients
Personal progress view: inline scoring explanation for each department type

title: Production Workflow Rebuild
description: The Production section has been completely rebuilt from the ground up for the Multimedia team. A redesigned detail drawer, visual status pipeline, production type tracking, fixed notifications, video/image file uploads, team role avatars, and full progress score integration.
highlights: New side-drawer detail view with status pipeline progress bar
Production Type field (Videography, Photography, Edit Only, Web) — now feeds Team Progress scores correctly
Tabbed detail view: Details / Files / Comments
File uploads now support video, images, PDFs, docs (up to 500 MB)
File list shows type badge, size, and direct open/delete actions
Stats strip on the production list with click-to-filter
Search bar + Production Type filter added
Delivered status added to filter
Full notification pipeline — all status changes, mentions, and revisions now trigger emails via createNotification
Team Progress (multimedia) now respects multimediaRole field (videographer / photographer / editor / all)
Archive/restore production projects
Ctrl+Enter to send comments, @ mention autocomplete

title: Google Sign-In & Login Refresh
description: Sign in with Google — staff use @esirom.com accounts linked to their profile; clients can match existing emails or register as new users. The login page has been redesigned with Google as the primary option and a cleaner two-column layout.
highlights: Continue with Google on the login page
Staff: @esirom.com Google accounts linked to existing profiles
Clients: Google email must match on-file accounts; new users can register via Google
Redesigned login card with logo header and improved layout

title: Password Reset & Security Enhancements
description: Users can now reset forgotten passwords directly from the login page! We've implemented a complete forgot password system with secure token-based email verification, plus enhanced UI consistency across all pages for a seamless experience.
highlights: Forgot password functionality with email reset links
Secure token-based password reset (1-hour expiration)
Branded password reset email templates
Dedicated reset password page with validation
Desktop/tablet UI consistency improvements across Dashboard, Overview, and Workflow
Mobile header and navigation alignment enhancements

title: Production Workflow & SLA Tracking
description: Introducing the Production Workflow system for managing video projects, motion graphics, and animations! Track SLAs, manage project statuses, and collaborate with your team using @mentions and real-time notifications.
highlights: Production project management with SLA tracking
Video-specific statuses (Editing, Rendering, Final Review)
@mention system for team collaboration
Reference link support for animation/motion graphics
Automatic notifications for status changes and mentions
DELETE endpoint for production projects

title: Content Bank & Workflow System
description: Streamline your content creation with the new Workflow and Content Bank features! Submit concepts, get client feedback with @mentions, track approval statuses, and manage your entire content lifecycle from ideation to publication.
highlights: Content Bank workflow with client approval system
Concept submission with reference images and attachments
@mention support in concept feedback
Automatic notifications for workflow updates
Admin role simulation (viewAs) for testing different user perspectives
Enhanced concept upload returning full concept data
Multiple workflow statuses: Draft, In Review, Approved, Rejected, Published

title: Instagram to Facebook Mirroring & System Improvements
description: New Instagram to Facebook mirroring feature allows you to display Instagram posts with Facebook branding in the content calendar! Plus, we've fixed notification visibility issues and optimized the production environment for better performance.
highlights: Mirror Instagram posts to Facebook in the content calendar
Separate KPI tracking for Facebook when mirroring is enabled
Fixed toast notification visibility and positioning
Database migration tools for seamless updates
Optimized Tailwind CSS for production use
Enhanced API endpoints with migration support

title: Automated KPI Tracking & Database Storage
description: KPI tracking just got smarter! Goals now automatically update with real-time data from your dashboard metrics. Set up multiple platform goals in seconds with our new Bulk Add feature, and all your configurations are now securely stored in the database for seamless access across devices.
highlights: Auto-tracked metrics: Reach, Engagement, Impressions, and Engagement Rate
Bulk goal creation for multiple platforms at once
Database storage for persistent KPI goals and platform settings
Visual indicators showing auto-tracked vs manual KPIs

title: Dynamic Updates System
description: What's New section now updates automatically! We've implemented a dynamic changelog system that tracks all platform improvements and displays the latest updates on the login page.

title: Admin Panel & Multi-Brand Support
description: Introducing the powerful Admin Panel! Manage users, clients, and platform updates all in one place. Plus, clients can now be assigned to multiple brands for seamless multi-brand management.

title: KPI Management & Theme System
description: Track your progress with our new KPI Management System! Set platform-specific goals, monitor progress with visual indicators, and switch between light and dark modes for comfortable viewing.

title: Welcome to Agency Hub!
description: Your all-in-one social media management platform is here! Track performance across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, X, and TikTok with comprehensive analytics, audience insights, and advertising metrics.
